tabs.overview: Used on pilot projects and spacing tests more than on routine pads; the event cloud shows fracture height, length, and azimuth against the well spacing.
tabs.engineering: Array depth and distance limit the detection; velocity model from logs.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Microseismic monitoring
function: Geophone arrays in an offset well or on surface that locate the small seismic events of fracture growth, mapping the treated volume in real time.
